title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $61,300 as Tech Stock Futures Rally
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Trades Near $61,300 as Tech Stock Futures Rally The bitcoin price traded near $61,300 on Friday as tech stock futures jumped ahead of a shortened Wall Street session, putting bitcoin on track to snap a seven-week losing streak. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Near $61,300 as Tech Stock Futures Rally first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
